description: This Java source file defines a Spring Security configuration class that customizes security settings to allow unrestricted access to the root URL and the H2 console, and disables CSRF and frame options to facilitate access to the in-memory database console during development.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class extending WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to customize web security settings, specifically to permit access to the root and H2 console paths and disable security features like CSRF and frame options.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default security configuration to set authorization rules and disable CSRF and frame options for the HttpSecurity object.
